decisions.briefing: NASDAQ +2.6% and S&P 500 +1.8% today mark a strong risk-on session, but with only $89.29 cash on hand (well below the $500 deployment threshold), there isn't enough capital to open a meaningful new position even though 3 slots are open. Holding all 7 existing positions unchanged and letting the automatic stop-loss/profit-target rules manage them.

market_education.summary_en: Markets rallied broadly today, with the NASDAQ up 2.6% and the S&P 500 up 1.8%, reflecting a risk-on tone across equities. No specific news headlines were provided for today's session, so this move reflects general market data rather than a single catalyst. Broad-based gains like this often signal improving investor sentiment toward growth and technology names.
market_education.summary_zh: 今日大市普遍上揚，納斯達克指數升2.6%，標普500指數升1.8%，反映投資者風險胃納增加。今日未提供具體新聞標題，故此升勢反映的是整體市場數據而非單一事件推動。這類廣泛上漲通常顯示投資者對增長型及科技股的信心正在改善。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: Even on a strong risk-on day, a portfolio with very little uninvested cash simply can't chase every opportunity — there's no capital left to deploy. Disciplined investors avoid forcing trades they can't properly size, and instead wait for cash to free up (via sells or deposits) before adding new positions.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 即使今日大市造好，若組合內現金極少，也無法追逐每個機會，因為根本沒有資金可運用。有紀律的投資者不會勉強做出資金規模不足的交易，而是等待現金（透過賣出或注資）釋放後，才再開新倉。
